pages.home.our_vision.title: We're changing the way students approach mathematics
pages.home.our_vision.description: At Mindventure, we believe that mathematics is not learned through rote memorization or endless hours of chaotic work. Whether we're talking about a student forming their first logical skills or a young person applying to top universities abroad, success comes from strategy, rigor, and clarity. We've created an elite learning space, right in the heart of the Pipera community, to give every student the tools they need to turn their potential into remarkable mathematical performance.
pages.home.how_we_work.title: Deep understanding, visible results
pages.home.how_we_work.description: Four pillars on which we build every student's journey, regardless of age or program.
pages.home.how_we_work.list_item.text_1: Before formulas, we want to understand how they think. We assess their current level, identify any blocks, and discover each student's learning style to build a real connection.
pages.home.how_we_work.list_item.text_2: A path built strictly around their goal — whether it's overcoming the fear of math in the early school years or achieving a 7 on the IB. No generic programs; we advance at their own pace.
pages.home.how_we_work.list_item.text_3: The child learns "why," not just "how." Meaning comes before the formula, and mistakes become a step toward learning, not an obstacle. We work with resources calibrated precisely to the target level, connecting concepts to the world around them.
pages.home.how_we_work.list_item.text_4: We constantly analyze progress. Parents and students receive transparent feedback, seeing exactly which topics have been consolidated and what still needs work.
pages.home.programs.title: Three programs: from the first steps to the final exams.
pages.home.programs.description: No matter where the child starts, we take them forward along the same math path — built on understanding, not memorization.
pages.home.programs.list_item.descriptio: The solid foundations on which everything else is built — logical thinking and confidence, not rote memorization. We help students master the fundamentals, clearing early the gaps that block performance later on.

Dedicated preparation for excellence in the IB Math exam. We lock in complex concepts, develop clear strategies for solving exam questions, and turn difficult material into logical, approachable steps.

One-on-one mentoring for the Internal Assessment essay (20% of the final IB grade). We guide step by step, from choosing an original topic and correctly applying mathematical models to structuring the work according to the official IB criteria.
pages.home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
pages.home.faq.q_item.a_1: All sessions take place in person, at the Mindventure studio in the Erou Iancu Nicolae area. Our location is strategically chosen to be as convenient as possible for families in the community. We work exclusively in very small groups (usually 1–4 students). This premium format lets us adapt to each student's pace and give them our full, personalized attention.
pages.home.faq.q_item.q_2: Is the studio for students in the Romanian system or those in international schools?
pages.home.faq.q_item.a_2: Both. The Mindventure structure is designed to be flexible. For students in the national system, we focus on clearing the gaps left from the early school years and on understanding mathematical logic. For students in international schools, we offer preparation calibrated natively to the IB curriculum, using its specific terminology and adapted resources.
pages.home.faq.q_item.q_3: From what age or grade can children start at Mindventure?
pages.home.faq.q_item.a_3: We work with children from the age of 7–8 (2nd grade / Year 3). The earlier the foundation of logical thinking is built, the faster the gaps disappear, and the road to the final exams becomes simpler, more natural, and stress-free.
pages.home.faq.q_item.q_4: How can I tell what progress my child is making during the program?
pages.home.faq.q_item.a_4: We believe in complete transparency. Throughout the sessions, we constantly analyze each student's progress and send periodic progress reports. You will always know which topics or gaps have been successfully covered and what still needs work for them to reach their full potential.
pages.home.cta.title: Discover the Mindventure studio
pages.home.cta.description: We invite you to the studio for a first meeting. We see where your child stands, how they think, and how we can guide them toward exceptional results — whether they're in the early grades or in high school.

pages.about.hero.description: Since 2008 I have guided entire generations of young people — in Romania and at the University of Bern. But beyond degrees and research papers, I am also a mother. And when you are both a teacher and a parent, you see things differently.
pages.about.credentials_section.item_1.d: Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Bucharest
pages.about.credentials_section.item_3.d: Guiding entire generations of students and pupils
pages.about.credentials_section.item_4.d: In both academia and the private sector
pages.about.story_section.title: Why I created Mindventure
pages.about.story_section.description_1: I did research and taught mathematics for years — in university and in industry, from logic and formal methods to real-world systems. I built my career on the idea that hard problems almost always have an elegant solution.
pages.about.story_section.description_2: After years spent in university and in research, I discovered something:
pages.about.story_section.description_3: the real value of mathematics lies not only in the results, but in the way it shapes your thinking.
pages.about.story_section.description_4: That is why I created Mindventure — a space where we connect with children, earn their trust, respect each one’s pace, and show them that mathematics is beautiful, logical, and alive.
pages.about.quote_section.quote_1: Even as a little girl I would line up my toys and "teach" them made-up stories. Today I do the same thing — except my stories are about
pages.about.quote_section.quote_2: logic, exploration, and the play of thinking
pages.about.quote_section.sub_quote_1: I want every child who comes through Mindventure to feel that
pages.about.value_section.title: What that means for your child
pages.about.value_section.list_item_1.te: The same standards I bring to teaching at university and to research — adapted to what each age can grasp.
pages.about.value_section.list_item_2.te: I respect each child’s pace and build trust first. Without the freedom to make mistakes, there is no real learning.
pages.about.value_section.list_item_3.te: The goal is not to retain formulas, but to think mathematically — a skill that stays with them long after the last exam.
pages.about.academic_section.title: The full academic background
pages.about.academic_section.text: Publications, research, conferences, and teaching at the University of Bucharest — all on my academic page.
pages.ib_math.hero.description: Exclusive group of maximum 4 students, coordinated by Denisa Diaconescu, Associate Professor, Doctor in Mathematics. Our studio in the Erou Iancu Nicolae area offers the ideal space for performance, adapting to the requirements of large international schools.
pages.ib_math.hero.media.caption: Derived, explained so that they remain.
pages.ib_math.program.section_title: We cover the entire IB Mathematics curriculum.
pages.ib_math.program.section_descriptio: Regardless of the path a student chooses, we structure the preparation to exactly match the rigors of the real exam. We ensure that every concept mastered translates directly into points earned according to the official scales.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.name: AA - Analysis & Approaches
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.profile: Recommended for students aiming for competitive faculties in fields such as Engineering, Physics, Pure Mathematics, Computer Science or Theoretical Economics.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.descriptio: We focus on algebraic rigor, complex functions, differential and integral calculus, trigonometry, and mathematical proofs.
pages.ib_math.program.track_1.advice: We place particular emphasis on managing Paper 1 (the test in which the use of a computer is prohibited), where pure mathematical logic and calculation speed are vital for a grade of 7.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.name: AI - Applications & Interpretation
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.profile: Recommended for students heading towards Business, Management, Social Sciences, Medicine, Psychology or Data Science.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.descriptio: The focus is on mathematical modeling based on real data, matrices, advanced inferential statistics, probabilities, and optimization.
pages.ib_math.program.track_2.advice: This profile is highly technological. We teach students how to quickly run statistical simulations and algorithms on the graphical computing (GDC) to solve long investigation problems without wasting precious time.
pages.ib_math.program.helper_1: Not sure which profile or level (SL / HL) suits you?
pages.ib_math.program.helper_2: During the initial assessment at Mindventure, we not only test current knowledge, but also analyze the student's admission goals to recommend the optimal path that maximizes their chances of success.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_1.title: Clarity of concepts
pages.ib_math.hww.method_1.description: We directly and practically explain all the concepts from the official curriculum, providing students with the theoretical foundation necessary to address any type of problem.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_2.title: Logical decomposition of complex problems
pages.ib_math.hww.method_2.description: We teach young people how to approach difficult topics. We train them to break down complex statements into logical, clear, and easy-to-follow steps.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_3.title: Making the use of the graphics calculator more efficient
pages.ib_math.hww.method_3.description: We teach young people how to make the most of their graphing calculator (GDC) during the IB exam for exceptional results.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_4.title: Time management and exam strategies
pages.ib_math.hww.method_4.description: We develop personalized strategies for approaching questions, managing time effectively, and eliminating stress during the exam.
pages.ib_math.hww.method_5.title: Intensive training on real topics (Past Papers)
pages.ib_math.hww.method_5.description: We constantly monitor young people's progress on official exams from previous years and ensure that the approach to each exercise strictly adheres to the official criteria in the IB scales.
pages.ib_math.hww.section_description: At Mindventure, we don't encourage rote memorization or endless hours of chaotic work. We completely change the way students approach IB mathematics, transforming complex concepts into clear solution algorithms.
pages.ib_math.trainer.section_title_1: An international academic path dedicated to your child's success.
pages.ib_math.trainer.section_descriptio: I am Denisa Diaconescu. I am an Associate Professor at the Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics (University of Bucharest) and a PhD in Mathematical Logic. Since 2008, I have been guiding entire generations of students and young people, instilling in them the rigor of analytical thinking.

I have conducted research and applied mathematics in both academia and industry. After a career dedicated to cutting-edge science, I chose to use this experience to help the next generation. That’s why I founded Mindventure — a math studio designed to train young minds for success and independence, transforming uncertainty into logical clarity and exceptional results. Whether I’m helping a first-grader find their confidence, or guiding a high school student to a perfect score on their IB or high school final exams, I apply the same philosophy: meaning comes before formula.
pages.ib_math.trainer.cv_1: If you want to know more about my professional career,
pages.ib_math.faq.section_description: The most frequent questions about IB mathematics — from choosing the path to when it's worth starting.
pages.ib_math.faq.ask_card.title: Didn't find your answer?
pages.ib_math.faq.ask_card.description: Tell us your child's specific situation and we'll give you an exact answer, in a free 30-minute assessment.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_1.question: How are the groups structured and what happens if a student is in a different profile?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_1.answer: At Mindventure, groups are strictly homogeneous and have a limited number of maximum 4 students. We never mix different years of study (DP1 with DP2) nor different profiles. Young people from Analysis & Approaches (AA) work in completely separate groups from those from Applications & Interpretation (AI), respecting the specific curriculum of the chosen profile.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_2.question: How do you ensure that the curriculum taught coincides with that at my child's international school?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_2.answer: All our courses strictly follow the official guidelines issued by the International Baccalaureate Organization (IBO). Being aware of the specifics of each school in the area, we adapt the pace and the synthesis materials so that young people see an immediate correlation between their performance in the studio and the grades obtained in class.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_3.question: Why is the initial assessment mandatory and what does it consist of?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_3.answer: The IB exam is far too complex to start preparing "blindly." The initial 45-minute assessment is not a stressful grading test, but a diagnostic tool. We analyze the student's logical thinking, identify any gaps, and establish a personalized strategy aligned with the young person's academic goals.
pages.ib_math.faq.q_4.question: Are the training sessions held physically or online?
pages.ib_math.faq.q_4.answer:
At Mindventure, we strongly believe that math excellence is best built through direct interaction. By working "side by side" with young people, we can track their every step of reasoning in real time, instantly correcting small errors in logic or writing that make a difference in official scales. 

 That is why our courses are held exclusively physically, in the Mindventure studio in the Erou Iancu Nicolae area. Our location is strategically chosen to ensure maximum convenience for families in the community, being in close proximity to the major international schools in the North of the Capital: American International School of Bucharest (AISB), Cambridge School of Bucharest, Mark Twain and Olga Gudynn. Thus, students can reach us quickly, directly after the end of school courses.
pages.ib_ia.hero.title_2: from the grade. Let's make it count.
pages.ib_ia.hero.description: The mentoring package in carrying out the Internal Assessment (IA). We guide you from choosing the topic to the final form — criterion by criterion, exactly how the IB examiner thinks. Program coordinated by Assoc. Prof. Dr. Denisa Diaconescu, Doctor in Mathematical Logic.
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.title: Five criteria, criterion by criterion
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.description: The IA is the only component in the IB structure where there are no unforeseen elements. The success of the exploration depends on a rigorous writing strategy, in which each page responds directly to a specific criterion in the official scale.
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.list_item_1: rigor, logical coherence and concise argumentation - an easy-to-follow work
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.list_item_2: correct notation, terminology, clearly labeled graphs and tables
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.list_item_3: originality of the research topic and independent thinking in approaching the subject
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.list_item_4: critical analysis of the results obtained and nuanced recognition of the limitations of the chosen model
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.list_item_5: relevance, correctness and, at the HL level, academic depth
pages.ib_ia.criteria_section.notice: Points are not lost for lack of knowledge, but for lack of academic structure. The maximum grade is earned for communication and reflection — chapters that we finish together, step by step.
pages.ib_ia.process_section.title: From a simple idea to a work that you fully master.
pages.ib_ia.process_section.description: We build your IA methodically. Our structured approach completely eliminates the pressure of deadlines and gives you the time you need to finish the communication and reflection details — the chapters that make the difference in your score.
We start with something that really interests you and that "has math" right at your level. We avoid topics that examiners have seen thousands of times. We provide you with a list of elite topics ideal for the path you want to follow further.
We build the logical structure of the essay. We establish a clear and concise writing plan from the beginning, ensuring that we rigorously cover all IB assessment criteria, keeping the argument dense, focused and easy for the examiner to follow.
Mathematics, correct and at the level

We work on correctness, notation, and the right level — calculus and algebra for AA, statistics and modeling for AI. We help you integrate computational simulations (including small Python code scripts where the assignment requires it), demonstrating to the examiner genuine personal involvement and complete mastery of the technology.
We develop the part where most students lose precious points: how you demonstrate your own thinking, how you interpret the data obtained, and how you critically analyze the limits of your mathematical model.
We provide you with detailed, criterion-by-criterion feedback through a trial moderation conducted before the official handover. This way, you know exactly where you stand and what details you can still optimize to maximize your grade.
pages.ib_ia.process_section.notice_1: Academic integrity for a secure grade.
pages.ib_ia.process_section.notice_2: We guide you step by step,
pages.ib_ia.process_section.notice_3: throughout the process, but the writing of the essay is entirely up to you. Authenticity is the key to success in the IB assessment.
pages.ib_ia.deliverables_section.title: What does your IA mentoring package include
pages.ib_ia.deliverables_section.descrip: We do not work with isolated interventions, but through a structured program in stages, adapted to your school calendar. We meet regularly, from choosing the topic to the final version sent to the IB. The package includes everything you need to achieve a maximum grade.
pages.ib_ia.deliverables_section.list_it: Support in choosing the right topic
We make sure the idea you choose "has" solid math relevant to your level, before you waste whole weeks on a subject that could be rejected at school.
You get a clear drafting plan, strategically divided across the 5 IB assessment criteria. You know exactly what each section must contain to keep the argument dense, focused, and easy to follow.
Support for modeling and digital analysis

We help you correctly implement formulas, graphs and, where the topic requires it, integrate digital simulations or algorithms (including support for Python scripts), providing that element of originality examiners look for.

As you write the work, you receive detailed, paragraph-by-paragraph reviews. We tell you exactly which elements in the text earn you points and where you risk losing them, using the specific language of the IB examiner.

Before you send the official work to the school, we carry out a final assessment based on the official 20-point scale. You get a realistic estimated score and last-minute corrections to eliminate any surprises at the real moderation.
pages.ib_ia.cta_section.title: Tell us the theme you're thinking about.
pages.ib_ia.cta_section.description: In a free assessment, we'll tell you whether your idea works and how to turn it into an IA that scores. No obligations.
pages.junior.hero.description: We build the foundation and confidence early, while it's still easy — through games, objects, and explanations that make sense to them. That way, math doesn't become "the hard stuff."
pages.junior.hero.social_proof: Small groups and 1:1 sessions, at the pace of each child.
pages.junior.statement_section.title_1: Math isn't hard. It becomes hard
pages.junior.statement_section.descripti: In the first years of school, two things take shape: the basic understanding and the child’s relationship with math. If gaps or fear appear now, they pile up by high school and cost dearly. We catch them early — and turn "I can’t" into "give me another one".
pages.junior.statement_section.card_item: First with your hand, then with your pencil
We use objects and games to help them understand concretely what numbers and operations mean — only then do we move on to paper.
Challenges, colorful worksheets, and little games, so they can practice often and with pleasure — the repetition that really catches on.
At his own pace, without pressure
Each child progresses at their own pace. We build confidence step by step, not a race where they fall behind.
pages.junior.method_section.title: How we make them like it
pages.junior.method_section.description: Children learn when they understand, not when they memorize. So we start with the concrete and play until it becomes theirs. That fundamental “Why?” becomes theirs — the one that turns mathematics from a school obligation into a natural way of understanding the world around them.
pages.junior.coverage_section.title: Learning that makes sense, alongside any school curriculum
pages.junior.coverage_section.descriptio: No matter which system your child studies in (Romanian, British, or international), mathematics has the same foundations. We help children lock in the basics, but beyond that, we build the essential skills they need to excel at school and in future exams:
pages.junior.coverage_section.stage_item: We start from physical objects and hands-on examples, so that the basic concepts are first seen and understood, not just memorized mechanically off a page.

We teach children how to approach a new task or a complex text, how to turn a written problem into a calculation, and how to take the first steps when they feel overwhelmed by a new problem or concept.
We prepare the child's mind for abstract thinking early on. We turn equations, variables, and geometric properties from sources of confusion into logical tools they handle with ease.
A success mindset, and clearing the blocks

Every session is designed to clear the gaps left from previous years. We turn the fear of making mistakes into curiosity, giving the child the certainty that their mind is strong and always capable of finding solutions.
pages.junior.parents_section.title: What is important to you?
pages.junior.parents_section.list_item.t: Real attention for every student. We're there for each of their questions.
You see clearly how your child starts to master the concepts and solve problems on their own, without feeling math as an obligation any more.
Our goal is not just a grade in the moment, but a child who discovers their potential, sheds the fear of making mistakes, and gains confidence in their own abilities.
The base we lay now, in the first years of school, is exactly the one on which success in the big exams is built years later.
pages.junior.parents_section.notice_1: Junior is the beginning of the same path.
pages.junior.parents_section.notice_2: The foundation we are laying now, in the younger grades, is exactly the one that will build, years later, a 7 on the International Baccalaureate. The earlier it starts, the easier the road is.
pages.junior.cta_section.title: Start with a free evaluation
pages.junior.cta_section.description: 30 minutes in which we see where the child is, what they like and where we start. No pressure, no obligations.
